items.title: Texas Pacific Land (NYSE:TPL) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings
items.summary: West Texas landowner Texas Pacific Land (NYSE:TPL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 31.2% year on year to $246.1 million. Its GAAP profit of $2.23 per share was 2.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
